name: Meris V
description: Meris V was a chilly, barren wasteland in the Meris system of the Elrood sector. The landscape of Meris V was mostly composed of rocky wastes, and was orbited by a single moon. Meris V remained unexplored, and there remained many undiscovered ore deposits on the rocky world.
